overview.heading: What Is a Long-Distance Relocation?
body: A long-distance relocation generally means a relocation of more than about 100 miles, and an interstate relocation is any relocation that crosses a state line, like Washington, DC to North Carolina, Texas, or California. These relocations take more planning than a local relocation: scheduling pickup and delivery windows, protecting belongings for a long ride, and coordinating timing on both ends.

Quest Professional Services handles long-distance and interstate relocations from Maryland, Washington, DC, and Northern Virginia to every state in the continental U.S. (we don't serve Alaska or Hawaii). You get one point of contact, a clear plan, and an upfront quote before anything is loaded.

included: Relocation plan with pickup and delivery windows

Delivery and placement at your new home

approach.heading: How We Plan an Interstate Relocation
body: A smooth long-distance relocation is mostly won before relocation day. We start by walking through what you're relocating, your timeline, and anything that needs special handling. Then we build a plan with your pickup date, a delivery window, and everything you need to know in between.
On the day, your belongings are wrapped and loaded for the long haul, not just a trip across town. At the other end we unload, set up furniture, and make sure you're settled before we leave.

faqs.q: How much does a long-distance relocation from Maryland cost?
faqs.a: Long-distance pricing depends mainly on how much you're relocating, the distance, your dates, and any packing or special handling. We don't quote a one-size-fits-all number; request a free quote and we'll give you an upfront price for your specific relocation.

faqs.q: Are you licensed for interstate relocations?
faqs.a: Yes. Quest Professional Services is U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and Motor Carrier (MC) certified (USDOT #3698493, MC #1293117), the federal operating authority for transportation across state lines. We're also licensed and insured.

faqs.q: Which states do you relocate to?
faqs.a: We relocate to and from all states in the lower 48. We do not serve Alaska or Hawaii.

faqs.q: How long does an interstate relocation take?
faqs.a: It depends on the distance and the size of the relocation. When you book, we'll give you a pickup date and a delivery window so you can plan your travel and your first nights in the new home.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I book a long-distance relocation?
faqs.a: As early as you can. Summer and month-end dates fill up first. Booking early gives you the best choice of dates and more time to plan packing.

faqs.q: Can you pack my whole house for a long-distance relocation?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer full-service packing, partial packing for fragile rooms like the kitchen, and unpacking at your new home. Long-distance relocations especially benefit from professional packing.

faqs.q: Do you also relocate businesses out of state?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle interstate business relocations too. See our business relocation page or mention it in your quote request.
